rule: A migration whose top-level DO block reads current_setting('<setting>', true) waits for an operator to set <setting> on the production database. Each such gate is named here with the day the setting was set in production; scripts/guard/migration-approval-gates.py refuses an undeclared gate, an entry without that day, and an entry whose migration no longer holds the gate.

gates.how: ALTER DATABASE foundation SET foundation.adr_0194_drop_approved = 'yes', after the owner approved the drop; then foundation-release.sh migrate
